description: Expander for MIDI-CAT, placed immediately to the right of it, giving that MIDI-CAT a name of up to eight characters which a parameter's own context menu can address.

params.text: Starts MIDI mapping on the first empty slot of MIDI-CAT.

notes: the name is typed into the display on the panel.
with a name set, any parameter's own right-click menu gains a Map on entry bearing that name, for mapping or re-mapping it in this MIDI-CAT.
